_doc: Sound palette v3 for the Guide videos. Generated once by scripts/sfx.mjs (ElevenLabs), cached in public/sfx/v3. Edit a prompt → delete its file → re-run. Rules: bible/sound.md.

sounds.name: room-tone
sounds.prompt: Room tone of a large quiet museum gallery with marble floors and high ceilings: soft air, very distant indistinct murmurs and faint far-away footsteps, gentle natural reverb, no music, no close sounds, steady and calm

sounds.name: step-1
sounds.prompt: One single light footstep of a small leather shoe on an old wooden parquet floor, close microphone, dry, no reverb tail

sounds.name: step-2
sounds.prompt: One single soft heel tap of a leather shoe on wooden floorboards, short, close, dry

sounds.name: step-3
sounds.prompt: One single small scuffing footstep on a wooden floor, leather sole, close and dry

sounds.name: hop
sounds.prompt: A small cartoon character does a little hop: tiny cloth whoosh then a soft two-foot landing thump on a wooden floor, playful, dry

sounds.name: cloth-1
sounds.prompt: Short rustle of a thick wool jacket sleeve during a quick arm gesture, close microphone, dry

sounds.name: cloth-2
sounds.prompt: Quick soft fabric swish of a coat as someone turns and points, close, dry, subtle

sounds.name: cloth-3
sounds.prompt: Brief cloth movement of a corduroy jacket and a leather satchel strap shifting, close and dry

sounds.name: loupe-out
sounds.prompt: A brass magnifying glass pulled out of a leather satchel: leather flap, soft scrape, then a small metallic click as it is raised, close, dry

sounds.name: loupe-move
sounds.prompt: A glass lens slides gently across a large canvas, soft airy glide with a faint glassy shimmer, subtle and smooth

sounds.name: loupe-away
sounds.prompt: A brass magnifying glass slipped back into a leather bag, soft leather thud and buckle click, close

sounds.name: air-1
sounds.prompt: Soft low cinematic air whoosh for a slow camera move, gentle and smooth, no high hiss, no impact

sounds.name: air-2
sounds.prompt: Gentle wide airy sweep as a camera glides across a vast painted fresco, warm, low and soft, no impact

sounds.name: air-3
sounds.prompt: Quick soft whoosh of air past the microphone, whip pan, short, warm, no metallic ring

sounds.name: tape
sounds.prompt: A strip of paper tape torn off and pressed onto a sheet of paper, crisp and close

sounds.name: pin
sounds.prompt: A small paper label pinned onto a cork board, tiny tap and paper flutter, close, dry

sounds.name: bubble
sounds.prompt: Very soft paper card flick, tiny and light, as a small note card appears, close and dry

sounds.name: ink-circle
sounds.prompt: Quick graphite pencil circling once on rough watercolour paper, close, dry

sounds.name: reveal
sounds.prompt: Soft warm reveal swell: low felt piano note with a gentle string harmonic bloom, magical but understated, short

sounds.name: sting-end
sounds.prompt: Short warm ending sting for an art-history video: two plucked mandolin notes and a soft string chord, resolved, cheerful, dry

sounds.name: tick-hmm
sounds.prompt: Tiny wooden tick, like a pencil tapped once on a desk, close and dry

music.name: bed-curious
music.prompt: Instrumental underscore for a short educational video about Renaissance paintings, told by a warm old Italian painter. Small chamber ensemble: pizzicato strings, mandolin, clarinet, light upright bass, soft brushed percussion. Curious, playful, gently mischievous, 96 BPM, steady and unobtrusive so a narrator can talk over it, no vocals, no big build, consistent dynamics, ends with a clean resolved final chord.

music.name: bed-wonder
music.prompt: Instrumental underscore for a calm art documentary short: felt piano, warm string quartet sustains, harp arpeggios, a solo cello line. Contemplative and luminous, 72 BPM, sparse and quiet so a narrator sits on top, no vocals, no percussion hits, ends on a soft resolved chord.
